messages:
Ethan: hey team — opening my first PR to add a small telemetry counter to model selection. Two quick things: do we need infra perms to add metrics? and what's the preferred PR size/description practice here?
Zara: welcome Ethan! for metrics you usually need access to `observability` project. Ping @infra-access with a short request, they add you to the `metrics-writers` group. Branches: `feat/<area>/<short>` or `chore/<area>/<short>`.
Ben: PR size: keep it focused. We like <= 300 LOC and one behavioral change. If it's just telemetry, mark it `chore/telemetry` and include a short note "no runtime changes" if true.
Iris: tests: add a unit that verifies the metric increments and a small e2e smoke if applicable. Run `make test-unit` and `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --telemetry` locally. CI will run the rest.
Ethan: thanks! also saw a failing CI job earlier in another PR — is `integration/metric` flaky? how should I handle flakes when they block merge?
QA-Bot: Known flake: `integration/metric` sometimes times out on overloaded runners. If CI fails with a timeout, re-run the job from GitHub Actions UI and ping #eng-ci if it keeps failing. Include logs in the PR when asking for help.
Zara: commit message: `telemetry: add model_selection_counter` and we squash merge. Include the motivation, test plan, and a rollout note in the PR body. Example PR template snippet:
```
- Summary: add counter for model selection
- Motivation: observe routing distribution for rollout
- Test plan: unit + smoke, CI green
- Rollout: behind flag `telemetry.model_selection` OFF -> 100%
- Backcompat: none
```
Ben: CODEOWNERS: if you add files under `observability/` add `@platform/observability` in CODEOWNERS. If it's only a small client change, leave owners as-is. If you add new top-level dir, add owner entry and mention them in the PR.
Ethan: squash merge yes? any special gating for telemetry? should I add a label?
Iris: we squash. Add labels `area/telemetry`, `risk/low` (unless it touches hot path), and `needs-review`. If it touches a latency-sensitive path, add `risk/medium` and include perf snapshots.
Ethan: one last: who do I ping for a quick 10-min pairing review? I'm new and prefer to pair.
Zara: ping @Ben for observability API and @Iris for tests. add "pair-review" in the PR title and someone will take ~10m. Congrats on the first PR!
Ethan: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll file the PR after getting `metrics-writers` access and include the checklist + labels. :party:
QA-Bot: Helpful links: https://redwood.dev/docs/pr-guidelines | https://redwood.dev/devops/metrics. New hire tip: run `./scripts/bootstrap && ./scripts/credentials_setup` after cloning.
